title: genista crotalarioides
intro: Genista crotalarioides, commonly known as French broom, is a flowering plant in the pea family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Genista crotalarioides include its ability to act as an emetic, purgative, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions like fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Genista crotalarioides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
